body.en: Confirm the Northern Cape reserve coordinates, accommodation type, gate times, payment, road condition, and written booking before starting the remote drive. Save the relevant page and contact details offline so a weak signal cannot turn uncertainty into trespass.

body.en: Check in with daylight remaining, ask staff where night observing is acceptable, and locate water, toilets, shelter, and the shortest route back to bed. Mark the exact vehicle position and walking line while they are still easy to recognize, then identify the simplest safe retreat.

body.en: Set up only on the approved stable surface near camp, protect optics from dust, and keep every lamp below eye level and away from neighbours. Allow eyes to adapt, keep screens dim, and place equipment where another visitor, resident, animal, or vehicle will not encounter it unexpectedly.

body.en: Finish before exhaustion, secure equipment against wind and animals, sleep in the booked unit, and reassess roads after sunrise. Pack deliberately, count small items, restore the surface, and use the preselected route rather than adding an unresearched stop after midnight.
body.de: Beende vor Erschöpfung, sichere Ausrüstung gegen Wind und Tiere, schlafe in der gebuchten Einheit und prüfe Straßen nach Sonnenaufgang neu.
